text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali chairs a cabinet meeting on training and employment.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui briefs Ben Ali on results of a meeting of the Tunisian-Mauritanian joint high commission in Nouakchott this week.
- British Minister of State at the Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs Ministry Jeremy Hanley ends a three-day visit during which he had talks with Tunisian officials on boosting economic cooperation.
- Ben Ali asks Abdelhamid Echeikh to chair the committee in charge of preparing the Mediterranean Games to be held in Tunisia in 2001.
- Tunisia celebrates Youth Day on Saturday.

- Tunisian Foreign Affairs Minister Habib Ben Yahia receives the U.S. envoy in Tunis and tells him of the need for a rapid conclusion of talks on the West Bank town of Hebron and the implementation of the Palestinian-Israeli peace accords.
